prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the best fit depends on your type of organization, goals, budget, and the services you need. I can recommend specific agencies if you tell me more about your situation, but here’s a quick way to get the right partner and what I’d look for when choosing one.

Quick questions so I can recommend agencies:
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, clinic/physician practice, med‑device, health tech/startup, behavioral health, etc.)
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, digital ads, SEO, content, PR, physician recruitment, product launches)?
- Annual marketing budget or monthly spend range?
- Timeline and geographic focus (local St. Louis only, regional, national)?
- Any must‑have capabilities (HIPAA/compliance experience, CRM/EMR integrations, telehealth marketing, multilingual outreach)?

How to choose the best agency (key criteria)
- Healthcare experience: proven work with similar organizations and regulated healthcare marketing.
- Measurable results: case studies showing KPIs (leads, conversions, ROI, CAC).
- Compliance knowledge: HIPAA and healthcare advertising rules.
- Full stack vs. specialty: do you need integrated services (strategy, creative, digital, PR) or a niche specialist?
- Technical capabilities: analytics, CRM integrations, EHR/portal experience.
- References and reputation: client references, industry awards, and reviews.
- Communication and culture: responsiveness, reporting cadence, and team fit.
- Pricing model and contract flexibility.

Where to look for reputable options
- Clutch.co and UpCity (reviews and shortlists)
- LinkedIn and local business networks
- Case studies on agency websites and client references
- Local healthcare marketing awards or St. Louis Business Journal lists

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a short list of St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies tailored to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or a set of interview questions to evaluate agencies
- Compare 3–5 agencies side‑by‑side based on your priorities

Which would you like me to do next?
